$$

$$

$$

d = 0.5 \cdot g \cdot t^2 = 0.5 \cdot 16.54 \cdot (1.38)^2
$$

$$
t^2 = 1.38^2 = 1.9044
$$

$$
d = 0.5 \cdot 16.54 \cdot 1.9044 = 8.27 \cdot 1.9044 \approx 15.75 \, \text{m}
$$

$$
\boxed{15.7} \, \text{meters}
